requirement_text: Online pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal is mandatory for all non-EU students residing abroad [...] who require a Study Visa to enter Italy and enrol at Sapienza. [...] Restricted Access Courses: For courses with a numerus clausus (restricted access), the Universitaly application will only be validated if the candidate is among the winners in the official ranking.
researcher_notes: This is exactly the non-scalar quota structure the research brief specifically warned about for Italy: for numerus-clausus (restricted-access) programmes, meeting every stated academic requirement does not guarantee a place -- the Universitaly pre-enrolment itself is only validated if the candidate places among the winners of the official ranking, i.e. a fixed quota of places allocated by competitive ranking, not a pass/fail bar. Deliberately NOT recorded as a numeric threshold, since Sapienza's own page states no such number -- the quota's size and the ranking cutoff vary by programme/cycle and are published in each course's own admission call, not on this general page.

requirement_text: The validation of a pre-enrolment application does not guarantee the issuance of a Study Visa (which is under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Italian Diplomatic Missions) nor does it guarantee university enrolment. [...] No Automatic Right to Visa: Prior acceptance by the university does not grant a right to a visa. No Automatic Right to Enrolment: Obtaining a visa does not grant an automatic right to enrol. Enrolment is the exclusive jurisdiction of the Higher Education Institution. [...] If Sapienza is unable to complete the enrolment of an international student due to missing requirements, the relevant Diplomatic Mission will be promptly notified for the immediate cancellation of the entry visa.
researcher_notes: Confirms three genuinely independent gates for a non-EU applicant, each of which can fail even when the others succeed: (1) university academic acceptance, (2) visa issuance by the Diplomatic Mission, (3) final enrolment by the university. A visa can be actively cancelled after issuance if enrolment ultimately fails. This is structural eligibility information, not a single pass/fail requirement, and does not reduce to any one scalar field.
